description.value: A community heritage museum split across two sites on Harris Road beside the CPR tracks in Pitt Meadows. The Hoffmann & Son Machine Shop houses over sixty restored stationary gasoline engines and a working forge, while the Old General Store (1908) features permanent and temporary exhibits on the area's settlement history plus a small community archives. Admission is by donation, making it an easy stop for touring cyclists passing through the Pitt Meadows area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active local museum with two sites on Harris Road; the OSM record maps to the Hoffmann & Son Machine Shop at 12277 Harris Rd. The website shows current 2026 events and open hours, confirming the museum is operating. Phone 604-465-4322 is on the website but absent from OSM. The website spells the name 'Hoffmann' (double-f, double-n) while OSM has 'Hoffman'. No evidence on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any of the optional cycling amenities.
concerns: OSM name uses 'Hoffman' (single f, single n) but the website consistently spells it 'Hoffmann' (double f, double n).
OSM has no phone number; website lists 604-465-4322.
OSM record represents only the Hoffmann Site; the museum operates as a single entity across two sites (General Store at 12294 and Hoffmann at 12277).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating local heritage museum and attraction on a cycling-accessible route through Pitt Meadows. Donation-based admission makes it a low-barrier stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: The Hoffmann machine-shop site of the two-site Pitt Meadows Museum — 60+ restored engines and working forge; kept as the machine-shop listing while the General Store pair resolves to one record.
